pr_title: fix: rebuild project tree from scratch when listing tests
pr_body:
Instead of filtering tests assuming there are no two projects with same name we always rebuild test tree from scratch and restore previos test results in the list mode.

Fixes https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/issues/30396

issue_context.title: [Bug]: Missing projects/tests when using multiple projects (folders) from 1.43.x
issue_context.body: ### Version 1.43.1 ### Steps to reproduce 1. Folder structure: 2. Playwright config: ``` export default defineConfig({ ... /* Configure projects for major browsers */ projects: [ // all tests except send money { name: 'setup', testDir: './utils', testMatch: /auth.setup\.ts/, }, { name: 'chromium', use: { ...devices['Desktop Chrome'] }, dependencies: ['setup'], testDir: './tests/all-tests', }, { name: 'firefox', use: { ...devices['Desktop Firefox'] }, dependencies: ['setup'], testDir: './tests/all-tests', }, // send money tests { name: 'send-money-setup', testDir: './utils', testMatch: /send-money-auth.setup\.ts/, }, { name: 'chromium', use: { ...devices['Desktop Chrome'] }, dependencies: ['send-money-setup'], testDir: './tests/send-money-tests', }, { name: 'firefox', use: { ...devices['Desktop Firefox'] }, dependencies: ['send-money-setup'], testDir: './tests/send-money-tests', }, ... ``` ### Expected behavior In previous version (1.42.1) UI mode / tests runner has all tests grouped by projects: ### Actual behavior In latest version (1.43.1) UI mode / tests runner contains only one folder, set unique name for project doesn't change anything. ### Additional context _No response_ ### Environment ```shell System: OS: macOS 14.4.1 CPU: (12) arm64 Apple M2 Pro Memory: 82.56 MB / 32.00 GB Binaries: Node: 19.7.0 - ~/.nvm/versions/node/v19.7.0/bin/node Yarn: 1.22.19 - ~/.nvm/versions/node/v19.7.0/bin/yarn npm: 9.6.1 - ~/.nvm/versions/node/v19.7.0/bin/npm pnpm: 8.15.7 - /opt/homebrew/bin/pnpm bun: 1.0.19 - ~/.bun/bin/bun Languages: Bash: 3.2.57 - /bin/bash ```
comments: This has something to do with the projects with clashing names, I can reproduce it with this https://github.com/yury-s/bug-30396 but not with unique names https://github.com/yury-s/bug-30396/tree/unique-project-names. It is a regression in 1.43.1 (was working in 1.43.0).
@andrzej-hanusek-tg did you create two projects with the same name on purpose? Playwright tooling might be not ready to work with your config even if we fix this exact issue.

review_comments: The test covering this code is failing!

Removed `this._options.onUpdate();` from onBegin/onEnd in testSuiteUpdater but I don't quite like it. Alternatively, we could restore the results in the onBegin of the reporter created in _createReporter.
